cues.text: Listen to me quickly, while you can still tell which one I am.
The voices aren't yours and they aren't lying to you. Those are different problems and you'll want to keep them separate.
And don't sleep. I'm serious. Whatever you think a bed is for, it isn't for you anymore.
That's all I have. That's honestly all anyone gave me.
Off you go. You've got everything. Try not to end anything.
...but that won't be a concern much longer.
